sources.title: Heterogeneous-Reliability Memory: Exploiting Application-Level Memory Error Tolerance
sources.snippet: This paper summarizes our work on characterizing application memory error vulnerability to optimize datacenter cost via Heterogeneous-Reliability Memory (HRM), which was published in DSN 2014, and examines the work's significance and future potential. Memory devices represent a key component of datacenter total cost of ownership (TCO), and techniques used to reduce errors that occur on these devices increase this cost.
